correctness.rationale: Orthogonality of four-character matrix is equivalent to vanishing M_A(b-b'). For 4|d nonzero, a sum of four pth roots cannot vanish because Phi_p divisibility would imply p divides 4 (p odd). Therefore every spectral A and B is a transversal modulo 4; every such A admits all p coset-translates of p Z4 as spectra. For 4∤d, factor 4pth roots via CRT over Q(i); cyclotomic irreducibility forces Gaussian integer coefficients of each p-fiber equal, and equal zero since an empty fiber exists for p>=5; for p=3 a fiber partition 2+1+1 cannot cancel as two fourth roots do not sum to one fourth root. Fiber zeros classify antipodal pairs for odd d and p/3p-spaced pairs for d=2 mod 4. The compatible four-clique classification gives p^4 spectra for p Z4 cosets, p^2 for noncoset two antipodal pairs, and p for other transversals. Independently exact-exhausted p=3,5,7 and obtained histograms {3:72,9:6,81:3}; {5:600,25:20,625:5}; {7:2352,49:42,2401:7}; these support but do not replace the universal proof.
